profile.name: Arduino I/O控制模块
profile.description: 基于Arduino的通用微控制器I/O模块，可提供数字输入/输出、模拟电压采集、PWM输出、脉冲输出以及舵机控制等功能。实验室中常用于连接简单传感器、读取开关或模拟信号、驱动指示灯与小型执行器，并实现基础自动化控制与原型验证。
profile.description_en: A general-purpose Arduino-based microcontroller I/O module that provides digital input/output, analog voltage readback, PWM output, pulse generation, and servo control. In laboratories, it is commonly used to interface simple sensors, read switch or analog signals, drive indicators and small actuators, and support basic automation and prototyping.
